title: Extension of scalars to $E$ is a localization on bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\cO_E$, and let $X$ be a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian. Then the functor
$E\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E}-\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)\to
D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ of [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars]
is a localization functor with respect to the class $W_{\ell^{\mathbf N}}$
[sk-def-sfb-rationalization]. This is the class of morphisms of the triangulated
$\mathbf Z$-linear category $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$
[sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] whose mapping cone is killed by some power $\ell^n$.

proof.text: Give E the norm induced by its fixed embedding into the algebraic closure. The valuation ring, its continuous condensed coefficient object, and its inclusion into E agree definitionally with continuousIntegers, integralCoeff and integralScalarMap of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Thus the existing compatibility isomorphism of [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars] identifies the stated restricted functor F followed by the rational inclusion with the integral inclusion followed by the actual functor L = integralScalarExtension. The preservation proof [lem-sfb-extend-scalars-bounded-constructible] is retained unchanged. No coefficient ring or functor is replaced.

Use the proved integral specialization [lem-weil-pbc-padic-integers-bounded-triangulated] for the source. The derived extension/restriction adjunction supplies the shift compatibility and triangulated structure of L in the ambient derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. Only the integral bounded subcategory needs to be triangulated. The rational bounded subcategory is used through its fully faithful additive inclusion, so no arbitrary-coefficient or rational Serre assertion is needed here.

The supporting lemma derived_nsmul_isIso in [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-integral-image] makes multiplication by ell invertible on every ambient rational derived object. Its powers are invertible by induction using composition of scalar identities. If a cone Z is killed by ell^n, additivity makes ell^n id_{LZ} zero, and cancelling this invertible scalar identity makes LZ zero. Apply [lem-kun-distinguished-cone-zero] to the image triangle. The compatibility isomorphism from step 1 and reflection of isomorphisms by the full inclusion show that F inverts W of [sk-def-sfb-rationalization].

The already declared theorem [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-integral-denominators] gives, for a map f between L-images of integral bounded constructible objects, an integer n and an integral map g with ell^n f = Lg. The compatibility isomorphism transports this equation to the restricted functor. The already declared integral-model theorem [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-integral-model] gives an integral bounded constructible preimage up to isomorphism for every rational bounded constructible object. Lifting that isomorphism through the full inclusion proves essential surjectivity of F. These reuse the integral-generator, finite-cone and bounded-truncation construction of the unit, rather than rebuilding its lattice and gluing arguments.

To prove equality detection, fix integral bounded constructible K and B and the scalar-localization unit cocone t for B. Use [lem-weil-pbc-integral-localization-complex-model] to represent B by a strictly bounded-below complex with its specified telescope comparison. Reindex the lifted natural-number telescope to AsSmall naturals. Its good-truncation map is a termwise isomorphism, so the displayed continuity cocone is a genuine termwise colimit with a uniform cohomological lower bound. The private bounded-devissage and isomorphism-transport helpers of [lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-sequential-hom], applied to [lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-sheaf-hom], prove shifted Hom continuity for K. At shift zero, transport along shiftFunctorZero and undo the indexing equivalence. Now [lem-weil-pbc-integral-localization-colimit-transport] identifies Hom(K,t), reindexed by lifted naturals, as a filtered colimit of abelian groups.

If Lf = Lg, apply the derived adjunction Hom equivalence and naturality of its unit to get f followed by the unit of B equal to g followed by that unit. The zeroth telescope leg is that unit: the inverse scalar has exponent zero. Equality of two representatives of a filtered colimit is witnessed at one common later stage. The indexing category is thin, so its two transition arrows agree. An induction on that stage shows that the scalar-sequence map from zero to n is ell^n times the identity. Postcomposing f and g therefore gives ell^n f = ell^n g. This is the proved private lemma integral_scalar_map_eq, with no new sorry.

Factor F through the rationalization Q using step 3, obtaining G and QG isomorphic to F. G is additive and integer-linear by the localization descent lemmas. For morphisms between Q-images, [lem-sfb-rationalization-scalar-fractions] represents every morphism after multiplication by a power of ell by Q of an integral map. For injectivity, clear both denominators, use equality detection from step 6 and the equality clause of the scalar-fractions theorem, then cancel the invertible scalar in the rationalization. For surjectivity, step 4 writes ell^n f = Fg; precompose Qg with the inverse scalar identity and cancel the scalar on the rational side. Conjugating by Q.objObjPreimageIso extends full faithfulness to all objects. Essential surjectivity follows from step 4. Thus G is an equivalence, and Functor.IsLocalization.of_equivalence_target proves precisely the stated localization instance.

proof_origin.place: F1, 2026-10-18: Proposition 6.8.14(2), using the existing integral-model and clear-denominator declarations. Equality detection is proved by bounded-source Hom continuity and the specified scalar-unit telescope. The source triangulation is the valid integral specialization; the cone argument runs in the ambient rational derived category.
